questions.question_text: What are the main components of a Decision Support System (DSS)?
questions.answer_key: The main components of a DSS include hardware, software, data, models, and user interface. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of Business Intelligence and its relationship with Decision Support Systems.
questions.answer_key: Business Intelligence refers to the process of collecting, analyzing, and presenting data to support decision-making. Decision Support Systems are a type of Business Intelligence system that provides a framework for decision-making. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)

questions.question_text: Describe the phases of the decision-making process and how Decision Support Systems support each phase.
questions.answer_key: The phases of the decision-making process include intelligence, design, choice, and implementation. Decision Support Systems support each phase by providing tools and models for data analysis, scenario planning, and decision evaluation. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)

questions.question_text: What is the role of Automated Decision Systems in Business Intelligence?
questions.answer_key: Automated Decision Systems use artificial intelligence and machine learning to make decisions without human intervention. They play a crucial role in Business Intelligence by enabling rapid and accurate decision-making. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of Big Data Analytics and its relationship with Business Intelligence.
questions.answer_key: Big Data Analytics refers to the process of analyzing large datasets to extract insights and patterns. It is a key component of Business Intelligence, as it enables organizations to make data-driven decisions. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)
